Here’s a clean **side-by-side comparison of Whova vs. PheedLoop** based on the agreements you uploaded and the Whova package deck you shared. I’ve also layered in pricing options so you can clearly see costs and inclusions.  

---

# 📊 Whova vs. PheedLoop – Feature & Pricing Comparison

| Category | **Whova (Standard Package)** | **PheedLoop (Agreement ID 4640)** |
|----------|-----------------------------|----------------------------------|
| **Core Platform** | End-to-end solution: registration, event website, mobile app, check-in, badge printing, reporting | Core Events Dashboard: backend access, reporting, speaker/sponsor portals【9†source】 |
| **Mobile App** | iOS & Android; personalized agendas (30 days), interactive floor maps, branded logos/colors | iOS & Android; personalized agendas, messaging, notifications; optional white-label for extra cost【9†source】 |
| **Event Website** | Website builder + embeddable widgets | Event Website bundled with registration; customizable sections & widgets【9†source】 |
| **Registration** | Built-in system, customizable, integrates with Stripe (fees apply) | Full registration & payment/refund system, badge printing, promo codes; 1.9% service fee【9†source】 |
| **Badge Management** | Name badge generator (pre-print + onsite scanner) | Badge printing included via check-in software (add-on $950/event)【9†source】 |
| **Speaker Management** | Collect bios/photos; Speaker Center for self-uploads (including co-speakers) | Call for Abstracts system (included); speaker contracts, review panels【9†source】 |
| **Sponsor Visibility** | Standard sponsor listings; advanced upgrades available (ads, profiles) | Sponsor/exhibitor applications included; exhibitor lead retrieval add-on ($199/booth)【9†source】 |
| **Engagement Tools** | Session chats, live Q&A, polls, gamification, photo sharing, attendee matchmaking, private group chats, surveys | Engagement built into app; advanced features (networking, polls, gamification) are *add-ons* at $950 each【9†source】 |
| **Analytics & Reporting** | Consolidated event reporting + post-event analytics | Basic data & reporting included; advanced analytics (SmartSight) $950 add-on【9†source】 |
| **Support & Training** | Dedicated account manager, customer success team, onboarding training | Essential Support Package included; 3 technical consults, office hours, PheedLoop University【9†source】 |
| **Accessibility** | Web platform (no download), pre- & post-event access | Virtual Event Portal included for hybrid/virtual events【9†source】 |
| **Customization** | Custom branding (logo, colors, headers) | White-label event app $950/event; org-level container app $2,450/year【9†source】 |

---

# 💰 Pricing Breakdown

### **Whova**
- **Per Event:** $3,499  
- **Bundle (2+ events):** $2,079/event  
- **6-Event Bundle:** $12,474  
- **Optional Add-Ons:**  
  - Virtual/Hybrid: $1,800/event  
  - 20 Sponsor Package: $2,200/event  
  - Session Capping/Private Schedules: $900/event  
  - Session Feedback Forms: $900/event  
- **6-Event Bundle + Add-Ons (sample):** $18,274  
- **Micro-Event Subscription (no app):**  
  - 4 events: $1,899  
  - Unlimited: $9,999 annually  
- **Transaction Fees:**  
  - Whova: 3% + $0.99/order  
  - Stripe: 2.9% + $0.30/order  

---

### **PheedLoop**
- **Base Price (per year):**  
  - 12-Month: $6,250/year【10†source】  
  - 24-Month: $5,625/year (with 10% discount)【9†source】  
- **Core Modules Included:** Dashboard, Registration & Website, Attendee Experience Package (app + virtual portal).  
- **Service Fees:** 1.9% for ticket sales【9†source】.  
- **Optional Add-Ons:**  
  - Gamification: $950/event  
  - Advanced Networking: $950/event  
  - Audience Interaction (polling, Q&A): $950/event  
  - Advanced Analytics: $950/event  
  - Badge Check-In/Printing: $950/event  
  - White-Label App: $950/event  
  - Remote Live Event Support: $450/day  

---

# 🔎 Key Takeaways

- **Whova** is more **all-inclusive**: engagement, gamification, and analytics come standard in the package price. Bundled pricing offers significant savings for multi-event organizations.  
- **PheedLoop** is **modular but add-on heavy**: base package looks lower per year, but many features (networking, polls, analytics, badges) require extra per-event spend, which can add up.  
- **Ease of Use & Support:** Whova is consistently top-rated (4.9⭐ on both app stores) and includes a dedicated success manager. PheedLoop offers strong backend control but less polish on attendee experience.  

---

👉 Would you like me to also build you a **cost projection model** (side-by-side) showing *actual annual costs* for 5–7 events under both platforms, including typical add-ons you’d likely need? That way, you’ll have a clear apples-to-apples financial picture.
